nodes.label: AI & Quant Analysis Backend
nodes.rationale: Core intelligence layer powered by TensorFlow.js, ONNX Runtime and Node.js. Research/simulation scope: the advanced engines are deterministic, seeded simulations used for wiring and regression tests — not connected to a live broker, a licensed feed, or a production training pipeline.

nodes.label: Explainable AI (XAI)
nodes.rationale: Reality check: calculateSHAP is a deterministic approximation — per-feature impacts are derived from seeded weights and then rescaled so they sum to the prediction delta — not an exact Shapley enumeration over feature subsets.

nodes.label: Federated Learning (FedAvg)
nodes.rationale: Reality check: the five clients are local placeholders; each client update is a seeded pseudo-gradient (clientUpdate), not the output of a real decentralized training run, and the round metrics (communicationEfficiency, performanceDrop) are static strings rather than measurements.

nodes.label: Hot Reload (modelManager.hotReload)
nodes.rationale: hotReload(newModelPath, newVersion) can swap an ONNX artifact in memory, but it has no caller in the current request path — it is a maintenance entry point, not a zero-downtime retraining loop.

nodes.label: Hierarchical Ensemble Engine
nodes.rationale: Reality check: the five base predictions are seeded, deterministic placeholders (generateBasePredictions derives them from a seeded RNG and a feature hash), not live inference from trained TCN/LSTM/gradient-boosted models; the softmax weighting, correlation matrix and outcome-driven weight updates are real code paths.

nodes.label: Design System: Cybernetic Quant
nodes.rationale: Visual language defined by the Tailwind CSS v4 tokens in src/index.css: layered dark panels (--color-surface, --color-surface-container*) with subtle backdrop blur and drop shadows; Inter / Plus Jakarta Sans for UI text, JetBrains Mono / Fira Code for numeric/terminal readouts, Vazirmatn for Farsi.

nodes.label: Concept Drift Detection (modelManager.monitorDrift)
nodes.rationale: modelManager.monitorDrift smooths the normalized prediction entropy with an EMA and reports detected:true once at least 30 samples have been observed and the score exceeds the threshold (0.65).

nodes.label: Retraining Recommendation (offline, operator-triggered)
nodes.rationale: Recommendation, not automation: the server monitors concept drift and recommends an offline retraining run; it does not retrain or hot-swap models on the request path. When drift is detected the response carries retrainRecommended:true and a warning is logged; no model version is fabricated and no weights are regenerated in-process.

nodes.label: State-Aware Highlight Color Channels
nodes.rationale: Color channels map to system states: Emerald = Growth/Buy (upward momentum, active profit, positive sentiment); Crimson = Risk/Sell (downward pressure, stop-loss warnings, sell signals); Amber = Caution (connectivity alerts, extreme volatility warnings, shadow-mode deviation anomalies); Telemetry Cyan = live values, active telemetry, focus indicators.

nodes.label: Canonical backtest result hashing (resultHash/configHash)
nodes.rationale: Canonical results include resultHash, configHash, and dataset/model/feature/normalizer/scenario hashes plus order transitions, fills, trades, equity, metrics, regime attribution, risk rejections, and quality warnings; undefined ratios (e.g. Profit Factor with no losses) are null with a machine-readable reason, never JSON Infinity.

nodes.label: Simulation provenance metadata (simulated:true, simulationType)
nodes.rationale: Design principle: every market, ledger, learning, and paper endpoint returns provenance metadata; generated data is marked simulated:true and empty ledgers stay empty instead of manufacturing sample records, making simulation explicit across all boundaries.

nodes.label: CODE-VERIFIED vs ASPIRATIONAL classification
nodes.rationale: Items are CODE-VERIFIED when the repository itself proves the state (a test or check fails if it regresses) and ASPIRATIONAL when the capability is simply not built yet.

nodes.label: Licensed real-time data absent (digital-twin/fixture fallbacks)
nodes.rationale: Several flows intentionally use labelled digital twins and fixture news/macro inputs; a licensed instrument master and timestamped quality-controlled feed are business dependencies. ASPIRATIONAL.

nodes.label: Model governance incomplete (signed model card/promotion)
nodes.rationale: Tracked ONNX artifacts still lack a signed model card, exact dataset hash, feature schema, scaler parameters, training commit, validation report, and promotion/rollback record. CODE-VERIFIED that the artifacts exist and are pinned (names, shapes, SHA-256); the governance artefacts are still missing.

nodes.label: No broker/OMS implementation (live-trading P0)

nodes.label: Deterministic paper simulator outcome rule
nodes.rationale: WIN if forecastAlignment==1 && confidence>=threshold, else WIN if regime==TRENDING_UP && side==BUY && confidence>=0.55, else LOSS; pnl = riskPerTrade*profitFactor on WIN else -riskPerTrade. Outcome is forecast-derived, not a broker fill.
